title: Three Seasons and One Short Fence
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：tail　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tail 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the keeper ① held the tail that no child in the zoo would have described, and he said the holding was the whole of the season. The ② tail, meaning the appendage itself and not the fence, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a tail, he said, is the only thing in a zoo that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ tail in that zoo had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ tail at the far shed, meaning the calf they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tail, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the keeper said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tail was the whole of the matter, meaning the balance and not the appendage. The ⑥ tail, meaning the balance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; tail, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both an appendage and a balance. He said the balance is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ tail had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ tail of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in March, was one zoo and three seasons of describing; tail, he said, is either the calf at the far shed or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tail I remember is the appendage described in the register, which closed in 1999 and is still described as the quietest in the zoo. A ⑩ tail, my mother said in 2001, is the only appendage that improves by being described; every tail, she said, is a balance that has agreed to look like an appendage. She said the balance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 尾巴（指兽舍里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 尾巴（指那条尾巴本身，与矮矮的围栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold the tail 捉这一条尾巴
D. n. 尾巴（指留给孩子们喂的那一头）
E. n. 尾巴之事（抽象总称，指一处兽舍的尾巴之事）
F. n. 尾巴（指饲养台账里写到、被描述的那一条）
G. n. 尾巴、平衡（指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 平衡（抽象总称，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: held the tail that no child in the zoo would have described
The tail, meaning the appendage itself and not the fence
the tail at the far shed
the tail was the whole of the matter
the tail had become a line in a register
The tail of the whole thing
A tail, my mother said in 2001

answers.why: hold the tail 意为“捉这一条尾巴”，1992 年那位饲养员把兽舍里没有一位孩子肯描述的一条尾巴做了一遍。
tail 意为“尾巴”，指那条尾巴本身而不是矮矮的围栏，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被描述。
tail 意为“尾巴”，指兽舍里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一道矮矮的围栏。
tail 意为“尾巴”，指最远那间棚舍的留给孩子们喂的那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tail 意为“尾巴、平衡”，指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条平衡就是那件事的全部。
tail 意为“平衡”，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条尾巴，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tail 意为“尾巴”，指饲养台账里写到、被描述的那一条，到 1997 年这一条成了饲养台账里的一行。
tail 意为“尾巴之事”，饲养员三月写道，整件事的尾巴之事是一处兽舍和三个季度的描述。
tail 意为“尾巴”，我记得的是饲养台账里描述过的那一条，1999 年养大了，至今仍被说成兽舍里最安静的一条。
tail 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，尾巴是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的尾巴。
